addon.name: Dreams & Nightmares Core
addon.author: atelier.dev
addon.description: Core ruleset for the Dreams & Nightmares setting. Defines character schema, ability scores, combat stats, and standard dice mechanics.

diceDefinitions.label: Ability Check (d20)
diceDefinitions.description: Standard ability check or saving throw

diceDefinitions.label: (Dis)advantage (2d20)
diceDefinitions.description: Roll two d20s and keep the highest/lowest

class_abilities.title: Rage
class_abilities.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. You can enter a rage as a bonus action, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and a bonus to melee damage rolls, but you can't cast or concentrate on spells while raging.

class_abilities.title: Unarmored Defense
class_abilities.description: While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

class_abilities.title: Bardic Inspiration
class_abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can inspire an ally with an encouraging word, giving them a die they can add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw of their choice.

class_abilities.title: Spellcasting
class_abilities.description: You've learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality in harmony with your wishes and music, casting spells from the bard spell list using Charisma as your spellcasting ability.

class_abilities.title: Spellcasting
class_abilities.description: As a conduit for divine power, you can cast cleric spells, drawing on the power of your deity using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

class_abilities.title: Divine Domain
class_abilities.description: You choose a domain related to your deity, granting you domain spells and other features related to that domain.

class_abilities.title: Druidic
class_abilities.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids, letting you leave hidden messages and recognize others who know it.

class_abilities.title: Spellcasting
class_abilities.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast druid spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

class_abilities.title: Fighting Style
class_abilities.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty, such as archery, defense, dueling, or great weapon fighting, gaining an associated benefit.

class_abilities.title: Second Wind
class_abilities.description: You have a limited well of stamina you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. As a bonus action, you can regain a small amount of hit points once per short or long rest.

class_abilities.title: Unarmored Defense
class_abilities.description: While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Wisdom modifier.

class_abilities.title: Martial Arts
class_abilities.description: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles using unarmed strikes and monk weapons, letting you use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls with them.

class_abilities.title: Divine Sense
class_abilities.description: The presence of strong evil registers on your senses like a noxious odor, and powerful good rings like heavenly music in your ears. You can open your awareness to detect celestials, fiends, and undead within a limited range a few times per long rest.

class_abilities.title: Lay on Hands
class_abilities.description: Your blessed touch can heal wounds, drawing on a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a long rest.

customFields.label: Lay on Hands Pool (5 x Level)

class_abilities.title: Favored Enemy
class_abilities.description: You have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to a certain type of enemy, gaining benefits when dealing with creatures of that type.

class_abilities.title: Natural Explorer
class_abilities.description: You are particularly familiar with one type of natural environment and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions.

class_abilities.title: Expertise
class_abilities.description: You gain expertise in two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill and your thieves' tools), doubling your proficiency bonus for ability checks that use either.

class_abilities.title: Sneak Attack
class_abilities.description: You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction, dealing extra damage once per turn when you have advantage or an ally is near your target.

class_abilities.title: Thieves' Cant
class_abilities.description: You've learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.

class_abilities.title: Spellcasting
class_abilities.description: An event in your past, or in the life of a parent or ancestor, left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with arcane magic, letting you cast sorcerer spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability.

class_abilities.title: Sorcerous Origin
class_abilities.description: You choose a sorcerous origin describing the source of your innate magical power, such as draconic bloodline or wild magic, granting features at this and higher levels.

class_abilities.title: Otherworldly Patron
class_abilities.description: You have struck a bargain with an otherworldly being of your choice, such as a fiend or an archfey, who grants you magical abilities in exchange for service.

class_abilities.title: Pact Magic
class_abilities.description: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells, cast using a small number of recharging spell slots unique to warlocks.

class_abilities.title: Spellcasting
class_abilities.description: As a student of arcane magic, you have a spellbook containing spells that show the first glimmerings of your true power, cast using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

class_abilities.title: Arcane Recovery
class_abilities.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook, recovering expended spell slots once per day during a short rest.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

racial_traits.title: Breath Weapon
racial_traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a line or cone, matching your draconic ancestry. Each creature in the area must make a saving throw or take damage of the associated type.

racial_traits.title: Damage Resistance
racial_traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2.

racial_traits.title: Dwarven Resilience
racial_traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

racial_traits.title: Stonecunning
racial_traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

racial_traits.title: Fey Ancestry
racial_traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

racial_traits.title: Trance
racial_traits.description: You don't need to sleep. Instead, you meditate deeply for 4 hours a day, gaining the same benefit a human gets from 8 hours of sleep.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 2.

racial_traits.title: Gnome Cunning
racial_traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

racial_traits.title: Fey Ancestry
racial_traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

racial_traits.title: Skill Versatility
racial_traits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

racial_traits.title: Relentless Endurance
racial_traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

racial_traits.title: Savage Attacks
racial_traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

racial_traits.title: Lucky
racial_traits.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

racial_traits.title: Brave
racial_traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

racial_traits.title: Versatile
racial_traits.description: Humans gain a +1 bonus to all six ability scores, reflecting their adaptability and drive across the multiverse.

racial_traits.title: Ability Score Increase
racial_traits.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, and your Charisma score increases by 2.

racial_traits.title: Hellish Resistance
racial_traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

racial_traits.title: Infernal Legacy
racial_traits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast hellish rebuke once per long rest; at 5th level you can also cast darkness once per long rest.

background_feature.title: Shelter of the Faithful
background_feature.description: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples, shrines, and other established presences of your faith, and you have a network of connections among the faithful who can provide modest assistance.

background_feature.title: Criminal Contact
background_feature.description: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals, keeping you informed about local criminal goings-on.

background_feature.title: Rustic Hospitality
background_feature.description: Since you come from the common folk, you fit in among them with ease and can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them.

background_feature.title: Position of Privilege
background_feature.description: People are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcomed by high society, and common folk try to accommodate you and avoid your displeasure.

background_feature.title: Researcher
background_feature.description: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you don't know that information, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it.

background_feature.title: Military Rank
background_feature.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier, and soldiers loyal to your former organization still recognize your authority and influence.
